Stonewater appoints new Interim Chief Financial Officer
Having completed his six-month contract as Interim Chief Finance Officer, Francesco Elia leaves Stonewater this week.

John Bruton has been appointed as Interim Chief Financial Officer for the period until Kirsty Spark joins as permanent Chief Financial Officer in late November. A former Stonewater Executive Director of Finance who retired in 2022, John brings extensive financial, sector and organisational experience.
